title: The Leaning Plant

vr.look: A model is a copy of something real. A stimulus is something a plant responds to, like light.

models.name: Sunflower Stage 3
models.alt: Big yellow sunflower with green leaves

models.name: Sun (Large)
models.alt: Bright sun shining through clouds in a blue sky

steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Tranquil in Filter environments. Click Tranquil Forest, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Put the Sun low on one side. Lean the Sunflower toward it. Set the Water Jug on the other side and the Plant Seeds on the ground.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Turn your hand to lean it. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The stem grows toward ___. The roots grow toward ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add a sprout standing straight up: Sunflower Stage 1

vr.full: Your photo shows the Sunflower leaning toward the Sun, with the Water Jug and Plant Seeds.

studio.title: Point the plant

labels.done: All 4 plants are pointed the right way. Nice work, crew!

studio.look: Each picture is a model, a simple drawing of a plant. A stimulus is something a plant responds to. A response is the change in how it grows.
studio.do: Tap the arrow that shows which way it will grow, or drag the picture onto the arrow. Then tap the stimulus.

card.name: A lamp on one side
card.alt: Drawing of a sprout standing straight in a pot, with a lamp shining on its right
card.facts: A model. The lamp is on the right.

pairs.q: Which way will the stem grow?
pairs.ok: Yes! The stem grows toward the lamp.
pairs.miss: Try again. Where is the lamp?
pairs.placeMiss: Think about what the lamp gives off.

proof.alt: Orchid on a windowsill with its leaves and flowers leaning toward the window
proof.cap: A real plant leaning toward a window.

card.name: A seed planted upside down
card.alt: Drawing of a seed under the ground, with its tiny root pointing up
card.facts: A model. The white tip is the root.

pairs.q: Which way will the root grow?
pairs.ok: Yes! The root turns and grows down.
pairs.miss: Try again. Roots do not stay pointing at the sky.
pairs.placeMiss: Think about what pulls everything down.

proof.alt: Two dark seeds, each with a white root growing down
proof.cap: Real seeds. Each root grows down.

card.name: Wet soil on one side
card.alt: Drawing of a small plant with short roots, and wet soil under the ground on the left
card.facts: A model. The blue patch is wet soil.

pairs.q: Which way will the roots grow?
pairs.ok: Yes! The roots grow toward the wet soil.
pairs.miss: Try again. Where is the wet soil?
pairs.placeMiss: Think about what the roots are reaching for.

card.name: A pot tipped on its side
card.alt: Drawing of a potted plant lying on its side, with the stem pointing right
card.facts: A model. Light comes from all sides.

pairs.q: Which way will the stem grow?
pairs.ok: Yes! The stem turns and grows up again.
pairs.miss: Try again. Stems grow the opposite way from roots.
pairs.placeMiss: Think about how a plant knows up from down.

proof.alt: Potted plant whose stems hang over the pot, with the tips curving back up
proof.cap: A real plant. Its stems fell over, and the tips grew up again.

frames.lead: 1. Why does a plant by a window lean?
frames.starter: I think the stem leans because ___.

frames.lead: 2. Pick one picture. What did the plant respond to?

studio.full: You pointed all 4 plants and picked each stimulus. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

voice.brief: Welcome to the forest, crew. We film Scene 20, The Leaning Plant. Show me how a plant responds, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your four models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Tranquil, and pick Tranquil Forest. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Put the sun on one side. Lean the sunflower toward it. Put the water across from it. Then tell me why.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a sprout that stands straight up. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
